chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would, when he performed the funeral prayer over a deceased person, say takbir, then recite the testimony of faith. Then he would say takbir and send blessings upon the Prophet and his family and make supplication. Then he would say takbir and supplicate for the believing men and believing women. Then he would say the fourth takbir and supplicate for the deceased. Then he would say takbir and depart. But when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, forbade him from praying over the hypocrites, he said takbir and recited the testimony of faith, then said takbir and sent blessings upon the Prophet and his family, then said takbir and supplicated for the believing men and believing women, then said the fourth takbir and departed, and he did not supplicate for the deceased.

key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet, upon whom blessings are sent in the prayer
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ: the believing men and believing women for whom supplication is made
key_terms.الْمُنَافِقِينَ: the hypocrites concerning whom prayer was forbidden
key_terms.انْصَرَفَ: he departed after completing the prayer
key_terms.فَتَشَهَّدَ: he recited the testimony of faith
key_terms.كَبَّرَ: he pronounced the takbir in the funeral prayer sequence
key_terms.مَيِّتٍ: a deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله perform the funeral prayer, and what changed regarding hypocrites?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the order of the funeral prayer as practiced by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, including the takbirs, shahadah, salat upon the Prophet and his family, and supplications. It also distinguishes the procedure regarding hypocrites, for whom supplication for the deceased was omitted after Allah forbade praying over them.
